jsonld_raw.name: (430 G) MUSKY PETALS SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made with vegetable waxes.

Musky Petals | A captivating fragrance that weaves a symphony of notes, creating an unforgettable experience. Anise and gardenia emerge at the top, joining in the heart with the intoxicating aroma of jasmine and ylang. Vanilla notes and musks provide a velvety base.

Notes:
Top notes: anise, gardenia, orange.
Heart notes: jasmine, ylang-ylang.
Base notes: vanilla, musk.
